seo.title: Products | Example Brand
seo.description: A neutral demo of the C Retail Catalog & Content Foundation with product CMS and read-only Shopify catalog mapping.

pageHero.title: A product catalog with an editorial content layer.
pageHero.body: This page demonstrates the C catalog-content foundation. B profile projects do not generate or link this route by default.

slides.caption: A reusable hero for C profile product collections.
A place for launch context, collection notes, and merchandising cues.
A scalable section for future product lines.

productSpotlight.title: Cards come from the product workbench.
productSpotlight.body: Product cards combine Shopify-sourced media with Sanity-owned editorial copy when the retail machine profile is active.

blocks.title: Shopify supplies read-only catalog facts.
blocks.body: This foundation maps product identity and media; it does not include cart, checkout, payment, orders, tax, shipping, fulfillment, real-time price, or real-time inventory.

blocks.title: Publish catalog content through the workbench.
blocks.body: Use Shopify for the source catalog record, then use Sanity to create language pages, stories, and SEO.

blocks.title: The catalog can grow without reshaping pages.
blocks.body: The same product card and detail templates support additional products when the C profile is enabled.
